# NorthStar Studioz

> NorthStar Studioz is an independent mixed reality game studio and Meta Quest developer based in Mumbai, India, founded in October 2026 by Vikas Sahani. It is building hand-tracked games for Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S, designed to be played on the real furniture in the player's room. Its first game is in development; the name, details and release date are confidential until it is announced.

Key facts:

- Based in: Mumbai, India
- Founded: October 2026
- Founder: Vikas Sahani, a finance professional with a passion for games and new technology, who built side projects and published Android apps before founding the studio
- Team: one developer
- Target platform: Meta Quest 3 and 3S (Meta Horizon OS), standalone, no PC required
- Focus: mixed reality games designed for bare hands, with no artificial movement
- Contact: studioznorthstar@gmail.com

NorthStar Studioz is an independent developer and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta.
